name: Loader
hint: Five loaders sharing one size, speed and tone.
description: Five pure-CSS loaders with their own personalities: orbit for thinking, pulse for listening, bars for audio and data, dots for typing, ring for generic waits. Reduced motion falls back to a gentle fade.
intents: thinking animation for an AI reply
usage: Prefer Progress when you know the fraction, Skeleton when you know the layout. Use a loader for short unknown waits inside buttons, chat replies and small panels. Pick a `kind` (ring by default) and `size`, and set `label` to what is loading ("Checking code"); `showLabel` shows it beside the loader. If visible text next to it already says it, pass label="" so it is not read twice.
screenReader: A role="status" region named by `label` ("Loading"), read as visually hidden text unless `showLabel`; the drawing is hidden. With label="" the whole loader is hidden, for when text beside it already says what is loading.

dataProps.description: What is loading. Read by screen readers through a role="status" region; "" hides the loader from assistive tech (use when nearby text says it).
Show the label as text beside (or below) the loader instead of only to screen readers.
Which loader. "all" shows the five side by side (a sampler, not for real UI).
Width and height: sm 20px (inside a button or beside a line of text), md 40px, lg 64px (a panel or an empty page). A number sets it in px exactly.
Any other attribute (id, aria-*, data-*) goes to the root <span>. className and style are merged with the component's own.
